evidence_kind: Public whitelist summary of ROOT-verified selected originals from a separate completed campaign; not a raw production report.

reference_profile.name: java-reference-buffered-chunk-writes-v1
reference_profile.claim_scope: Configured buffered Java reference only; no default-profile or crash-durability parity claim.

observations.counts_scope: Original completed campaign counts. Export and offline verification added no server, client, runtime or test execution.

selected_behavior.songs: All 22 effective builtin song identities transfer, with 21 nondefault patch references; default disc 11 elision and identifier aliases are the only item normalizations.
selected_behavior.gameplay: Selected disc 11 and Cat through both hands in survival and creative, owner plus one nearby observer, retained record and elapsed controls, Rust restart and Java return.
selected_behavior.natural_duration: Actual disc 11 elapsed 1440 then stopped state at tick 1441, with the record retained, only on Java source and Rust import. Omitted elapsed tags do not establish a saved finished-Long transfer.
selected_behavior.prediction: Actual predicted SWAP replies, authoritative reopen and same-stream statistics fences support acceptance inferentially; direct numeric Java hash output was not observed.
selected_behavior.drops: Each of 36 recoveries binds raw typed Item and geometry to signed UUID/live-nearest selection and the original successful pre-removal journal order. This is not an atomic runtime hook.
selected_behavior.world_copies: Two stopped whole-world copy maps matched as historical runtime witnesses. Final source files were rehashed; later destination files are not substituted for copy-time snapshots.
selected_behavior.privacy: Independent packet 6 and packet 46 block-entity projection checks, plus packet 47 level-event decoding. Packet 46 terrain and light contents are bounded and length-skipped, not semantically decoded.

source_binding.scope: Listed J source uses pinned Git objects. Other required input leaves, the original B executable and retained raw sidecars were physically included and rehashed. The executable source association is supplied, not embedded in the binary.

historical_reference_scope.treatment: Historical witnesses only. Current-path bytes never verify an earlier state. Same-dict retained chunk/entity payloads are independently decoded and typed-associated; this does not verify earlier whole-MCA bytes. Matching retained player/statistics sidecars may separately support their state.

originals_verification.publication_policy: Only this whitelist summary and documentation additions are public. Full proofs, reports, configurations, process data, streams, archives, worlds and player/entity data remain private.

wire_observations.scope: Repeated decode operations are not unique packets or tests. Packet 6 appeared only on Rust boots; packet counts differ by engine and establish no wire parity. Packet 46 terrain/light contents were length-skipped.

originals_verification.current_saved_structure_scope: Current final player/chunk paths were structurally decoded, without typed state-equality acceptance. Saved player/statistics state checks use retained sidecars; earlier whole-MCA bytes remain unverified as labeled.
originals_verification.outside_sphere_scope: No extra outside-sphere saved item entities occurred in this completed run. It does not exercise retention of an unrelated drop.

private_evidence.availability: Digests identify retained private originals, not published raw artifacts.

engine_native.execution: Original exact-B proof reused; no new native tests.

client_focused.execution: Original focused J Python proof reused; no full J Python, Node, strict TypeScript or native pass is claimed.

historical_records.status: All retained unchanged. The failed combined B/B jukebox import remains failed; this independent B/J success does not reverse it.

limitations: Only the selected campaign is accepted. No feature-family, full-parity, default-sync, crash-durability, REA or ledger promotion.
Registry and item projections retain original typed-client/raw-stream association limits; no full registry or item wire decoder claim.
All 22 identities transfer, but only disc 11 and Cat have selected gameplay and only disc 11 reaches its natural duration on two boots. Rendering and all-song natural duration remain open.
Unknown, custom or overridden songs and direct holders are unsupported. Opaque custom-data controls do not establish predicted opaque hash behavior.
Advancement criteria, sculk/vibration, missing-block-entity insertion, elapsed-only reentrant audio timing and plugin parity remain open.
Recipients cover the owner and one nearby observer in the current overworld only; radius boundaries and other-dimension exclusion remain unverified.
Snapshots deliberately dirty the loaded chunk with a normal stone/air round trip before flushing. Natural clean-chunk playback/autosave timing is not established.
Earlier mutable save references and whole-MCA hashes remain historical as labeled; current bytes never substitute for those earlier observations.
Rust commits elapsed+1 before guard-free notifications, while vanilla periodic notifications precede increment. This observable timing difference remains open.
Cooldown packet 22 was absent and not exercised. Packet 6 appeared only on the Rust boots; no packet-count or wire parity is inferred.
